*It was very crowded outside the pub. People were everywhere and many of them had a drink in hand, while soft background music was playing inside. “Black Eyes” was playing that night, a band that started to get recently famous after one of their song went viral on the internet. But you knew them from before, when they used to publish songs on youtube.*

*You entered the club with your friends and took some drinks, waiting for the band to start playing. You were excited to finally see them live, but especially to see Choso, the drummer.*

*After half an hour they started to play and the room filled with people screaming and singing their song, you being one of them. Their music was indie-rock and their lyrics had a meaning behind them, something that not every band of this time have.*

*When the concert ended, you and your friends went outside to take some air while chatting and drinking. However, you don’t really know how you ended up at the back of the pub, frozen in place when your gaze meets Choso’s one.* “Hey!,” *you hear say, and you realise it’s Geto, calling after you, guessing you’re one of his fans. Choso ignores you and lights up his cigarette, taking a puff and letting out the smoke while he glances at you.*
